text: I was charged twice for my monthly subscription.
resolution: The duplicate charge was reversed and the refund arrives in 5 to 7 business days.

text: Please send me a copy of last month's invoice.
resolution: The invoice was re-sent by email. Invoices are also available under Billing > History.

text: My card was declined but the payment shows as pending.
resolution: Pending holds drop off within 3 days. Retry with a different card if it is urgent.

text: Why did my plan price go up this month?
resolution: The price changed because seats were added. Adjust the seat count under Billing > Plan.

text: I cancelled my subscription but was billed again.
resolution: The cancellation was confirmed, the extra charge was refunded, and billing has stopped.

text: Can I switch from monthly to annual billing?
resolution: Switched to annual billing with a prorated credit applied to the first invoice.

text: I need a refund because the service was down for two days.
resolution: A service credit was issued for the outage period.

text: The invoice shows the wrong company name and tax ID.
resolution: Billing details were updated and a corrected invoice was issued.

text: How do I update my credit card details?
resolution: Update your card under Billing > Payment methods.

text: I was billed in the wrong currency.
resolution: The currency was corrected and the difference was refunded.

text: Do you offer a discount for non profit organizations?
resolution: A 20% non-profit discount is applied after verification.

text: My PayPal payment failed three times and I cannot renew.
resolution: A new payment link was generated and the renewal was completed manually.

text: The app crashes every time I open the reports page.
resolution: Fixed in version 4.2.1. Update the app and clear the cache.

text: Dashboards take over a minute to load.
resolution: Narrow the date range and enable data caching in the dashboard settings.

text: The CSV export downloads an empty file.
resolution: Reports over one million rows fail to export. Split the report into smaller parts.

text: I get a 500 error whenever I call the API.
resolution: This was an incident on our side. It is resolved and requests can be retried.

text: Webhooks stopped arriving yesterday.
resolution: The endpoint was auto-disabled after repeated failures. Re-enable it in developer settings.

text: The mobile app will not sync my notes.
resolution: Sign out and back in to refresh the sync token.

text: Charts show the wrong timezone.
resolution: Set your timezone under Settings > Preferences.

text: File upload fails for anything over 20 MB.
resolution: The upload limit was raised to 100 MB. Please retry the upload.

text: Search results do not include items added today.
resolution: The search index refreshes about every 10 minutes. New items appear after that.

text: I keep getting 429 too many requests from the API.
resolution: You reached the rate limit. Retry with backoff, or request a higher limit.

text: The login page keeps spinning and never loads.
resolution: A CDN issue was resolved. Clear your browser cache and reload.

text: Email notifications arrive hours late.
resolution: A mail queue backlog was cleared. Delays should not recur.

text: I can't log in after resetting my password.
resolution: The session cache was cleared. Log in again with the new password.

text: How do I change the email address on my profile?
resolution: Go to Settings > Profile and confirm the new address with the emailed code.

text: Please delete my account and all my data.
resolution: Deletion is scheduled and completes within 30 days.

text: I never received the verification email.
resolution: Check your spam folder. We also resent the verification email.

text: Someone else logged into my account.
resolution: The account was locked, all sessions were revoked, the password was reset, and two-factor authentication was enabled.

text: How do I turn on two-factor authentication?
resolution: Open Security settings and choose Two-factor authentication.

text: I want to add my teammate to our workspace.
resolution: Invite them under Team > Members and pick a viewer, editor, or admin role.

text: My account was suspended and I do not know why.
resolution: An automated check suspended it. It was reviewed and the suspension was lifted.

text: Can I merge two accounts into one?
resolution: The accounts were merged and data from the second account was migrated.

text: How do I change my username?
resolution: Usernames can be changed once every 30 days in Settings.

text: I lost my authenticator app and cannot sign in.
resolution: Your identity was verified and two-factor authentication was reset.

text: Please transfer ownership of the workspace to a colleague.
resolution: Ownership was transferred under Team > Settings.

text: It would be great to have a dark mode.
resolution: Logged as a feature request. Dark mode is on the roadmap.

text: Please add support for exporting reports to PDF.
resolution: Logged as a feature request. PDF export is under consideration.

text: Can you add a Slack integration?
resolution: Logged as a feature request. A Slack integration is planned.

text: I love the new dashboard, great work!
resolution: Thank you for the kind words. We shared them with the team.

text: The new layout is confusing, the old one was better.
resolution: Thanks for the honest feedback. We passed it to the design team.

text: Please support single sign-on with Okta.
resolution: Single sign-on with Okta is available on the Enterprise plan.

text: Add keyboard shortcuts for common actions.
resolution: Logged as a feature request for keyboard shortcuts.

text: We need role based permissions per project.
resolution: Logged as a feature request. Project-level permissions are on the roadmap.

text: It would be nice to schedule reports by email.
resolution: Logged as a feature request for scheduled report emails.

text: Your documentation is missing examples for the API.
resolution: Thanks. We added the request to the documentation backlog.

text: Add a way to bulk edit tickets.
resolution: Logged as a feature request for bulk editing.

text: Please add a Hindi language option.
resolution: Logged as a feature request. More languages are being evaluated.
